states.required-if-supported: gate when capability probe says supported; otherwise evidence-backed skip
states.required-if-feature: gate when the fork carries/enables the feature; otherwise evidence-backed skip
states.required-if-state-format-checks: gate when state serialization is exposed
states.observe: collect evidence but do not gate
states.optional: may run; status must still be reported
states.not-applicable: feature intentionally absent; record capability evidence
